airdropRequests/$requestId.description: Server-initiated token airdrops from vault to users (e.g., Shopify purchases). Hook executes token transfer on document creation.

operationDetails.create: Only PROJECT_VAULT_ADDRESS can create airdrop requests. Hook transfers tokens atomically on creation.
operationDetails.update: Only PROJECT_VAULT_ADDRESS can update status after completion/failure.

notes: Use this collection for server-initiated token transfers (e.g., Shopify webhook processing). The vault must hold sufficient tokens. Create document with status='pending', hook executes transfer. Backend should set status='completed' or 'failed' after processing.
